description: bandlimited is a Pure Data external that generates square, triangle, saw, reverse-saw, saw-triangle, and pulse waveforms band-limited to the Nyquist frequency. It uses precomputed wavetables to reduce CPU usage and includes wrapper abstractions for individual waveform types.

research.notes: The creator’s forum post identifies the Gitorious repository as the project repository, but Gitorious is now defunct. No verified current GitHub or GitLab successor or separate issue tracker was found.
